author: Inside Edition
description: Former Dallas Cowboys quarterback and CBS Sports football analyst Tony Romo was pulled over on a highway in Wisconsin. An officer asked Romo to step out of the vehicle, but Romo said he was going to call his lawyer. He eventually got out and was handcuffed and was arrested on charges of  driving under the influence, according to the video. Because this is Romo's first alleged offense, the incident is being treated as a civil traffic infraction, not a criminal matter.
title: Video Of CBS Football Analyst Tony Romo's Arrest Revealed

author: Inside Edition
description: Dr. Anthony Fauci stayed silent as Republicans pummelled him on Capitol Hill. Fauci invoked his Fifth Amendment right against self-incrimination 111 times. Before questioning began, Fauci explained that he was pleading the fifth because he believed Senator Rand Paul and other republican senators were attempting to entrap him into saying something that could lead to perjury or criminal prosecution. When his attorney attempted to speak for him during the hearing, he was expelled. Democrats came to Fauci’s  defense, but the hearing was dominated by Republicans, who allege he is responsible for mistakes they claim he made during the Covid-19 pandemic.
title: Dr. Anthony Fauci Pleads The 5th Over 100 Times During Covid-19 Hearing

author: Inside Edition
description: A stranger entered a backyard and made off with a family dog. Inside Edition spoke with the dog's owner, Paul Torrez. The dognapping was posted to social media. Good Samaritans in Colorado Springs got to work trying to find the stolen dog. A family member of the suspect saw the video and apparently gave him a talking to. The suspect returned the dog while everyone was sleeping. The family says he also left behind a handwritten note of apology.
title: Dognapper Returns Dog To Family

author: Inside Edition
description: Anguish in the courtroom as dad Patrick Clancy recounted coming home to find his three young children strangled by their mom Lindsay Clancy, who jumped from the second story window of their home and remains paralyzed for life. Surveillance footage played in court shows Patrick walking into a pharmacy. He had been sent on errands by Lindsay, prosecutors allege, giving her time to carry out the killings. The defense claims Clancy is not guilty of murder and was suffering from postpartum depression and postpartum psychosis.
title: Patrick Clancy Described Finding Children Strangled At Wife's Murder Trial

author: Inside Edition
description: Oscar-winning Irish musician Glen Hansard has died. Reports say he was involved in a single vehicle motorcycle crash in Dublin. An investigation is ongoing. Hansard was probably best known for his performance in 2007's 'Once', a love story about two songwriters. He won the Academy Award for Best Original Song in 2008 for 'Falling Slowly.' Glen Hansard was 56. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Oscar-Winning Irish Musician Glen Hansard Dead At 56

author: Inside Edition
description: Rescue teams scoured the wreckage of a shopping mall, in hopes of finding survivors. This comes after a devastating 7.1-magnitude earthquake hit southwestern Japan on Tuesday. Police bodycam showed the extent of damage to the Aeon shopping center in the town of Kashima. Emergency crews descended into the lower levels of the retail center, searching for people still alive. Authorities report at least 18 dead and over 60 injured.
title: Emergency Crews Search Shopping Mall For Japan Earthquake Survivors

author: Inside Edition
description: This customer wasn't happy leaving this tennis store in Florida, his anger apparently caught on cell phone and surveillance video. It happened at Tennis Plaza in Doral. The customer appears to browse the store for a while, but then grabs a tennis racket and appears to break its netting on a clothing rack. Store staff went to check on him and that's when they reportedly said he threatened them. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Former Tennis Pro From Uruguay Arrested After Meltdown In Store

author: Inside Edition
description: A DNA test revealed a dark secret in Sophia Maddox's family tree.
title: Woman Discovers Charles Manson Was Her Grandfather #shorts
